A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.

Stopping the cooling water 
 circuit of condenser.

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the cooling water pump motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the cooling water pump motor.

The
 Condenser must be isolated mechanically by closing inlet and outlet valves.

Be sure Condenser must be 
 completely drained.

sections.text: العمل الذي يتعين القيام به
Condenser In Operation

Measure temperature at inlet and 
 outlet water in condenser and compare it with the setting value, then analyze 
 it and determine what to do.

Measure vacuum of condenser and 
 compare it with the setting value then determine what to do.

sections.text: المكثف خارج الخدمة

فحص المكثف بشكل كامل 
 الصرف

Check 
 the air service for cleaning is available .

تفكيك الامامي والخلفي 
 فتحة المكثف

Remove all the things which 
 resist and prevent passes the water through the pipe of condenser

Cleaning the pipes of condenser 
 by flexible shaft (first cleaning)

تنظيف أنابيب المكثف 
 بواسطة الهواء المضغوط حوالي 6 بار (تنظيف ثانية)

Cleaning the pipes of condenser 
 by compressed water about 6 bar (finally cleaning)

Fixing the condenser against 
 moving down during filling by lifting nuts under the condenser

Filling the steam space condenser with the demi-water up to 10 m level and 
 determine the leakage tubes and blend them by wood plugs
Draining the condenser after checking the tubes are not leakage.

Close the front and rear manhole 
 of condenser
Down the nuts under the condenser to the original position to release the condenser against moving.
Filling the condenser to the normal operation level.
